questions.text:
Consider the following directed graph:

Which of the following is/are correct about the graph?
questions.solution:
Following the arrows, the graph has three directed cycles:
- around the top-middle square (between the top two rows),
- around the bottom-left square through S,
- around the bottom-right square.

- A cycle means there is no topological order [latex]\text{---}[/latex] TRUE.
- A DFS from S reaches every vertex, and each of these three cycles produces exactly one back edge [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 3 back edges [latex]\text{---}[/latex] TRUE.
- Every graph has strongly connected components (at least single vertices) [latex]\text{---}[/latex] FALSE.
- Not every pair is mutually reachable (e.g. nothing returns from the top-right corner) [latex]\text{---}[/latex] FALSE.

Answer: Options 1 and 2

questions.text: Which of the following regular expressions represent(s) the set of all binary numbers that are divisible by three? Assume that the string [latex]\epsilon[/latex] is divisible by three.
questions.solution:
The DFA for "value mod 3" has states 0, 1, 2 (start and final 0); reading bit b moves r to [latex](2r+b)\bmod3[/latex].
- Option 1: from state 0, "0" stays; "1" goes to 1, [latex](01^*0)^*[/latex] loops 1 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 2 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 1, and the final "1" returns to 0 True
- Option 2: same paths written differently (11, or 10 to state 2, loop, 01 back) True
- Option 3: [latex](0^*X^*)^*=(0+X)^*[/latex] where X is the loop in option 1 True
- Option 4: cannot produce 1001 (= 9, divisible by 3) False

Answer: Options 1, 2 and 3

questions.text:
Consider a three-level page table to translate a 39-bit virtual address to a physical address as shown below:

The page size is 4 KB = (1KB =[latex]2^{10}[/latex] bytes) and page table entry size at every level is 8 bytes. A process P is currently using 2 GB (1 GB =[latex]2^{30}[/latex] bytes) virtual memory which os mapped to 2 GB of physical memory. The minimum amount of memory required for the page table of P across all levels is _________ KB
questions.solution:
2 GB / 4 KB = [latex]2^{19}[/latex] pages. Each page-table page holds 4096 / 8 = 512 = [latex]2^9[/latex] entries.

For the minimum, the pages are contiguous:
- Level 3: [latex]2^{19}/2^9=1024[/latex] pages
- Level 2: 1024 entries [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 2 pages
- Level 1: 1 page

Total = 1027 pages [latex]\times[/latex] 4 KB = 4108 KB

Answer: 4108

Let F(x, y) = foo(x, y, 10). Both values go 15 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 5 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [latex]-[/latex]5.
- F([latex]-[/latex]5, [latex]-[/latex]5) = 10
- F(5, [latex]-[/latex]5) = F([latex]-[/latex]5, [latex]-[/latex]5) = 10, and similarly F([latex]-[/latex]5, 5) = 10
- F(5, 5) = F(5, [latex]-[/latex]5) + F([latex]-[/latex]5, 5) = 20
- F(15, [latex]-[/latex]5) = F(5, [latex]-[/latex]5) = 10, so F(15, 5) = F(15, [latex]-[/latex]5) + F(5, 5) = 30
- By symmetry F(5, 15) = 30

F(15, 15) = F(15, 5) + F(5, 15) = 60

Answer: 60

questions.text: Let S be a set of consisting of 10 elements. The number of tuples of the form (A,B) such that A and B are subsets of S, and [latex]A\subseteq B[/latex] is _______
questions.solution:
For [latex]A\subseteq B\subseteq S[/latex], each element of S is in one of 3 states: not in B, in B but not A, or in A.

[latex]3^{10}=59049[/latex]

Answer: 59049
